item_groups.label: Routing logic
item_groups.meta: 3 of 3 approved · OMS rules · apply on the next release window

rules.name: Zone 7–8 default origin becomes West when the line has cover
rules.detail: Today the OMS picks the node with the deepest stock, which is almost always East. This makes proximity the first test and depth the tie-break, for Zones 7 and 8 only.

rules.name: Zone 5 tie-break by transit time, not unit cost
rules.detail: Zone 5 is genuinely split coverage and the current rule sends it wherever postage is a cent cheaper, which costs a day about a quarter of the time.

rules.name: Cheapest compliant service with promise headroom
rules.detail: Rate-shop every order but only accept a service whose committed transit clears the promise by the chosen margin. The margin is the whole argument between cost and CX.
rules.optionNote: One day of slack absorbs normal carrier variance without paying for air.

rules.name: Carrier allocation mix
rules.detail: Move volume between the two nationals and the consolidators. Meridian holds a contractual 55% minimum below which the tier discount resets, so the band is narrower than the rate card suggests.
rules.optionNote: Inside the 55% minimum with 1pp of margin. Service-level matched per zone.

item_groups.label: Packaging specs
item_groups.meta: 1 of 2 approved · 3PL pack instructions · box POs required

rules.name: Six SKUs into smaller box sizes
rules.detail: Care kit, filter 3-pack, whetstone, shears, spatula pair and paring knife move down one or two box sizes. Dim-weight ratios fall from 1.3–1.8× to about 1.0×.

rules.name: Two SKUs to poly mailers
rules.detail: Spatula pair and shears in mailers rather than boxes. Cheapest change on the list and the only one that moves the damage rate — 0.2 claims per thousand on those SKUs.

item_groups.label: Node inventory targets
item_groups.meta: 1 of 2 approved · hands to Planner via S9.3

rules.name: Reposition 4 fast movers to the West node
rules.detail: Skillet 10", skillet 12", filter pitcher and chef knife held at 21-day cover in Reno. This is what makes the Zone 7–8 routing rule actually fire instead of falling back to East.

rules.name: Raise West cover target from 15 to 21 days on 9 SKUs
rules.detail: Stops the West node dropping out of cover mid-week and bouncing orders back to East. Costs working capital and does not directly reduce postage.
